withai.title: Using wimui with AI
withai.intro: wimui ships a machine-readable map of the whole library so AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, v0, ChatGPT, …) generate real wimui screens — with the correct imports, the required CSS contract, and the composition rules that keep screens from looking AI-generated — instead of guessing. Point your agent at the files below and it composes from the actual API surface, not a hallucinated one.
withai.files_desc: Both are generated from the same sources of truth as this Storybook (catalog, docgen props, tokens, composition rules) and regenerated on every release.
withai.concise_use: Self-contained: setup contract, import paths, composition rules and the full component catalog. Small enough to paste whole or keep always-on in an agent's context. Start here.
withai.full_use: Everything inlined: per-component props from docgen, ready-to-paste recipes (setup / composed screen / auth / settings), and the full composition rules. Use when the agent needs to write real code.
withai.urls_desc: Hosted (tracks main — may include unreleased changes) or resolved from the installed package (the exact version you installed):
withai.prompts_desc: Give the agent the file, then ask for a screen. The prompt text below is intentionally in English — agents read it directly; the URLs and import paths are what matter.
withai.prompt_generic_title: Any agent or chat (paste the file, then ask)
withai.prompt_cursor_desc: Add the hosted llms.txt as a Doc (@Docs → Add new doc), or drop llms-full.txt into the repo and reference it with @. Then:
withai.prompt_claude_desc: Fetch it to a local file first, then point Claude Code at that file. Reading it straight from a URL goes through a summarising fetch, so a 3,000-line file may not land in context verbatim. If wimui is already installed, read node_modules/wimui/dist/llms-full.txt instead:
withai.prompt_v0_desc: Paste the concise llms.txt at the top of the conversation, then describe the screen. For real code, paste llms-full.txt instead.
withai.includes_desc: So it does not have to guess:
withai.inc_setup: The required CSS contract (styles.css) and setup (WimProvider, theme, density).
withai.inc_imports: The correct import paths — root barrel vs. category subpath vs. optional-peer subpaths (wimui/rhf, wimui/ai/streaming-text, …).
withai.inc_catalog: The full component catalog with descriptions, and (in llms-full.txt) real props from docgen.
withai.inc_composition: The anti-generic composition rules — the same ones this project follows to avoid AI-looking screens.
withai.note_version: The hosted files are redeployed on every push to main, so they can be ahead of the latest npm release. The package subpath matches the exact version you installed — pin to it for reproducible generations.
